title: Angela Rayner moves to protect pubs from being turned into houses or offices

paragraphs.en: All pubs will get protection from being turned into housing or offices under a shake-up of planning laws in England to be presented by Angela Rayner this week.
paragraphs.zh: 根据安吉拉·雷纳本周将提交的英格兰规划法改革方案，所有酒吧都将受到保护，免于被改造成住宅或办公室。

paragraphs.en: The housing secretary will publish a new national planning policy framework aimed at loosening planning laws even further to help build 1.5m homes by the end of the parliament.
paragraphs.zh: 住房大臣将发布新的国家规划政策框架，旨在进一步放宽规划法规，以帮助在本届议会任期结束前建成150万套住房。

paragraphs.en: The government had previously been consulting on whether to change planning laws to protect the last pub in an area from being turned into housing or commercial use, but the limits of that proposal prompted warnings from hospitality campaigners that thousands of pubs could be lost.
paragraphs.zh: 政府此前一直在就是否修改规划法规、以保护某一地区最后一家酒吧不被改作住宅或商业用途征求意见，但该提议的局限性引发了餐饮业活动人士的警告：数千家酒吧可能因此消失。

paragraphs.en: Ministers have now decided this will apply to all pubs facing the threat of conversion into another use.
paragraphs.zh: 部长们现已决定，该保护将适用于所有面临被改作他用威胁的酒吧。

paragraphs.en: Rayner is making the move because of concerns about the rate of pub closures in England, with Andy Burnham already having announced a cut in business rates for the hospitality sector. According to the Campaign for Real Ale (Camra), 794 pubs have closed this year, with 82 either being demolished or converted.
paragraphs.zh: 雷纳之所以采取这一举措，是因为担心英格兰酒吧的关闭速度。安迪·伯纳姆已宣布为餐饮业削减商业税率。据真麦酒运动组织（Camra）统计，今年已有794家酒吧关闭，其中82家被拆除或改建。

paragraphs.en: Pub and restaurant bosses have blamed the employer national insurance increase, the higher minimum wage and food price inflation as well as high business rates.
paragraphs.zh: 酒吧和餐厅老板将责任归咎于雇主国民保险上涨、最低工资提高、食品价格通胀以及高企的商业税率。

paragraphs.en: Under the changes, developers will have to prove there is no reasonable prospect of keeping a pub as a going concern, including evidence that it was marketed for sale for at least a year. Councils will need to consider whether losing a pub would deprive a community of a somewhere for people to gather.
paragraphs.zh: 根据新规，开发商必须证明没有任何合理前景能让酒吧作为持续经营的企业存续，包括提供酒吧已挂牌出售至少一年的证据。地方议会还需考虑，失去一家酒吧是否会剥夺社区中人们聚集的场所。

paragraphs.en: Rayner said: “Pubs are part of who we are as a nation. They’re where we celebrate, grieve, argue and belong, the beating heart of so many of our communities, and it’s an outrage that weak protections have allowed too many of them to slip away without a fight.
paragraphs.zh: 雷纳表示：“酒吧是我们这个国家身份认同的一部分。我们在那里庆祝、哀悼、争论、找到归属感，它们是许多社区跳动的心脏。脆弱的保护措施让太多酒吧悄无声息地消失，这令人愤慨。”
